<h1><small>Stage 1 · Sprout · Lesson 3 of 8</small>Read hundreds in a glance</h1>
<div class="fields"><span>Name <u></u></span><span>Date <u class="s"></u></span><span>Time <u class="s"></u></span><span>Score <u class="s"></u> / 20</span><span class="pass">Pass: 16 of 20</span></div>
<div class="howto"><p><b>Today's move.</b> Learn the look of each digit. Seven is the top bead plus two. Do not count beads one by one.</p><p><b>How.</b> Say the number the beads show, then write it. A grown-up covers each picture with a card after 2 seconds.</p><p><b>Stuck?</b> A bead only counts when it touches the middle beam. The top bead is worth 5, each bottom bead is worth 1.</p></div>
